frequency_question: How often does a contested, high-stakes regulatory nomination get successfully confirmed by the Senate within a tight window?
membership_rule: Cabinet or major agency head nominations (FDA, EPA, SEC, etc.) that faced intense political resistance or delay but eventually reached a floor vote.
provenance_note: 4 cases named, 5 claimed via skeleton x multiplier (1.2x)
coverage_note: 4 named key FDA confirmation battles; historically, even contested FDA nominees usually pass if the party holds the Senate or broad bipartisan backing exists.
known_gaps: Excludes lower-tier sub-agency posts that were completely withdrawn before hearings.
skeleton: Contested FDA nominations over the past 30 years where confirmation was achieved despite initial opposition.
multiplier: 4 hits out of 5 major nominations evaluated across recent administrations
validity_reason: Valid until the end of the current legislative/executive configuration cycle.
